name: Update Gym Invoice on Payment
script:
if doc.invoice:
    # Linked Gym Invoice uthayein
    invoice = frappe.get_doc("Gym Invoice", doc.invoice)
    
    # Balance update karein
    new_outstanding = max(0, invoice.outstanding_amount - doc.amount_paid)
    invoice.outstanding_amount = new_outstanding
    
    if new_outstanding == 0:
        invoice.payment_status = "Paid"
    else:
        invoice.payment_status = "Partially Paid"
        
    invoice.save(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Gym Invoice Auto Payment Entry
script:
# Agar Pay Now tha aur Amount Paid > 0 hai toh auto Payment Entry create aur submit karein
amount_paid = float(doc.amount_paid or 0)

if doc.payment_option == "Pay Now" and amount_paid > 0:
    pe = frappe.new_doc("Gym Payment Entry")
    pe.member = doc.member
    pe.invoice = doc.name
    pe.posting_date = doc.posting_date or frappe.utils.today()
    pe.amount_paid = amount_paid
    pe.payment_mode = doc.payment_mode or "Cash"
    pe.transaction_id = doc.get("reference__txn_id") or doc.get("reference_id") or ""
    pe.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    pe.submit()

name: Gym Payment Entry Sync Invoice
script:
if doc.invoice:
    inv = frappe.get_doc("Gym Invoice", doc.invoice)
    
    # Calculate all submitted payments for this invoice
    res = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT SUM(amount_paid) 
        FROM `tabGym Payment Entry` 
        WHERE invoice = %s AND docstatus = 1
    """, (doc.invoice,))
    
    total_paid = float((res[0][0] if res and res[0] and res[0][0] else 0.0))
    total_amount = float(inv.total_amount or 0.0)
    outstanding = max(0.0, total_amount - total_paid)
    
    status = "Paid" if outstanding == 0.0 and total_amount > 0.0 else ("Partially Paid" if total_paid > 0.0 else "Unpaid")
    
    # Update Gym Invoice values directly
    frappe.db.set_value("Gym Invoice", inv.name, {
        "amount_paid": total_paid,
        "outstanding_amount": outstanding,
        "payment_status": status
    }, update_modified=True)
